title: The Enablement Stack in 2026: a Candid Chat with Nate Vogel
summary: A discussion with industry veteran and Global Enablement leader Nate Vogel and Arist CEO Michael Ioffe
body_markdown:
Watch this private discussion with industry veteran and Global Enablement leader Nate Vogel (Pigment, Tableau, Gong, Databricks) and Arist CEO & Co-Founder Michael Ioffe, where they discuss what the Enablement tech stack will look like in 2026.


Undercover the leading frameworks, best practices, and latest shifts in Enablement across creation, delivery, and measurement.
